prize_parts.citation: for the development of targeted protein degradation, in which small molecules induce proximity between a target protein and an E3 ubiquitin ligase, as PROTACs and as molecular glues

statement.case_for: My preferred configuration is unchanged from round 1: B026 with Crews, Deshaies and Handa. The decisive point for me is that the mechanism can be stated in physical terms. A small molecule shifts a binding equilibrium so that a ternary complex of target, ligand and E3 ligase forms, and ubiquitination follows from the lifetime and geometry of that complex. That is measured by kinetics, thermodynamics and structure in many independent laboratories, and it holds for both heterobifunctional degraders and monovalent glues. One induced-proximity citation therefore covers both arms without becoming a list of drugs. The attributable core is compact: the PROTAC concept and first demonstration (Crews and Deshaies) and the identification of cereblon as the target through which thalidomide-type glues act (Handa). On the chair's maturity question my standard is mechanism established by independent quantitative confirmation, not regulatory approval. Approved lenalidomide-class glues act through exactly the cereblon mechanism, so the principle has already reached patients, and I do not apply approval of the PROTAC arm as a test.
statement.case_against: The strongest objection stands: no heterobifunctional PROTAC is approved, so the PROTAC arm rests on a trajectory, and the chair notes that nobody has verified current clinical status in this process. The three-person limit also excludes Ciulli, Sakamoto, Kim, Gray and Ito, and Sakamoto and Kim co-authored the 2001 report. Ito is inseparable from Handa on cereblon, and I would want the report to say so. Aqvist and Somfai are right that much of the visible success is pharmacology, and the citation must describe a chemical principle (induced proximity and ternary-complex design) rather than drugs. If the reports show that the glue arm and the PROTAC arm cannot honestly be credited as a single achievement, I would revisit the configuration.

responses.point: Approval of a drug is the wrong test for a chemistry prize; the principle is established by replication, ternary-complex structures and approved cereblon-dependent glues.
responses.response: I accept this and have moved to your standard. I applied approval of a PROTAC too strictly in my opening, and the glue drugs test the same mechanism in patients. I still want the citation worded around the mechanism and not around therapeutics, as you say yourself. On Ciulli replacing Deshaies, the 2001 proof of concept and Deshaies's cullin-RING ligase biochemistry are the origin of the idea, whereas Ciulli's VHL ligands and structures are optimisation of a principle that was already shown, so I keep the trio. I also thank you for your caution on nitrogenase, which I share.

responses.point: Ciulli's VHL ligands and crystallography of ternary complexes were decisive for rational design, and the committee should test whether he deserves a place before settling on the trio.
responses.response: This is the real attribution question and I do not dismiss it. Ciulli's structures are what turned the ternary complex into something one can design, and as a physical chemist I value them highly. But they explain and optimise a modality that Crews and Deshaies had already demonstrated and that Handa's cereblon work had already explained for glues. If the reports show that VHL-based design, and not the original concept, is what made the field general, I would consider Ciulli in place of Deshaies. Without that evidence I would not displace the person who proposed and demonstrated the concept. I would name Ciulli and Sakamoto in the history that accompanies the prize.

responses.point: The core chemistry of B026 is linker and ligand design on known E3 ligands, so much of it is biology and pharmacology; B026 can be backed only if maturity is stated honestly.
responses.response: I agree that the citation should say what is chemical: bringing two proteins together with a small molecule and thereby controlling a post-translational reaction. That is a new way of making a reaction happen, and the effect is quantitative. I also agree that maturity must be stated honestly: the PROTAC arm has no approved drug. I put B060 as my first alternative because the attribution is the cleanest on the list, and I find your point that the 2010 prize covered only C-C coupling convincing. But I judge B026 the more original chemical idea, and I would ask you to say whether the stated maturity condition is enough for you to support it in a final configuration.

responses.point: B026 was ranked eighth in the opening and Zou's final proposal is B060 with Buchwald and Hartwig, and I asked in round 1 to hear his objection.
responses.response: I thank you for the clean attribution argument for B060, which I accept, and for dropping Kosugi. My difference is that B060 is an extension of the palladium paradigm that was recognised in 2010, whereas induced proximity is a new principle. I note that you list B026 as an alternative and I ask whether you could support it with Crews, Deshaies and Handa. We are Stockholm University colleagues, which I disclose again, but that has no bearing on my judgment of B060.

responses.point: B067 is mature and the impact is not in doubt, but attribution between Solexa, 454 and others is the problem; Linke now treats it as a fall-back.
responses.response: I agree with your fall-back reading and I think it is sound. Maturity favours B067, but I cannot judge from the reports that reversible-terminator chemistry is separable from the 454 and Mayer lineages, and the question of fit with Chemistry rather than Physiology or Medicine remains open. I would want that settled before putting it ahead of B026. I also share your preference for one induced-proximity citation rather than two separate parts, and that is the configuration I propose.

uncertainties: Whether the expert reports show that Ciulli's VHL-based design, rather than the original concept, is what made PROTACs general enough to displace Deshaies.
Current clinical status of heterobifunctional degraders, which nobody in this process has verified.
Whether Ito and Sakamoto can be credited honestly as part of Handa's and Crews's contributions under the three-person limit.
Whether Somfai, Sparr and Zou will accept B026 as a final configuration; if the group splits, B060 is my first alternative.
statement.conflict_note: No tie to any credited name in B026 or B060. I remain a bioenergetics researcher and ask that my views on B028 and B001, which are close to my own field, be discounted. I am a Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, institutional only. Nothing in round 1 has changed this.
